messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick weekly readout — high level and three asks. TL;DR: ship EU private GA, get infra latency back to target, tighten unit cost by 10% this quarter.

Ava (CEO): Status: EU private beta went well with 5 pilot customers; legal signoffs mostly done. Next milestone is GA checklist + compliance runbooks by 04/10.

Ava (CEO): Incident recap: Friday ~02:15 UTC we had a P99 latency spike (~2h) caused by a combination of a misrouted fallback + KV cache evictions. No customer-facing data loss. Postmortem draft incoming.

Ava (CEO): Metrics snapshot (weekly): hosted API error rate 0.18% (down), median latency 85ms, P95 210ms, P99 420ms (above target). Cost per 1k tokens decreased 6% vs last month — good progress but below target.

Ava (CEO): Three asks — please ack with owners and ETA: 1) VP Eng: Can we get a mitigations rollout for the KV cache eviction pathology + new alerting (P99 > 300ms) by 04/03? 2) Head of Product: Lock the GA checklist and confirm only critical scope for GA (no new feature toggle changes) by 04/06. 3) Finance/Leads: Recommend immediate $Xk non-critical spend freeze and provide a prioritized list of investments to defend by 04/05.

Rohan (VP Eng): Acked. I’ll own #1. Plan: revert risky routing change in canary, add eviction guardrails, and push updated tracing. Targeting canary 04/01, prod rollout 04/03.

Rohan (VP Eng): Short note: autoscaler patch (optimize cold-start batching) is queued — we can include it in the canary if no regressions. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1284 :shipit:

Maya (Head of Product): On #2 — agreed to freeze scope. I’ll publish a locked GA checklist today and tag only critical fixes. No new model version swaps until GA is green.

Maya (Head of Product): Also starting a small gating eval for quality regressions on the canary cohort (prompt sets + customer traces). Will share dashboard link when ready.

Sam (Head of Finance): On #3 — will propose a list by 04/04. Immediate ask: pause vendor trials and non-essential cloud credits. We’ll keep runway and critical infra funding prioritized.

Jen (People Ops): Quick people note — hiring pause for IC roles except SRE and infra critical hires. Recruiting teams should submit exceptions to me with a short justification.

Rohan (VP Eng): deploy-bot — deploy canary to staging now so we can start smoke tests.

deploy-bot: Deployed infra/autoscaler-canary to staging (build 2026.04.01-089). Smoke tests: started. Logs: https://ci.redwood/12345/logs

Maya (Head of Product): One more ask from PMs — please make sure we have rollback playbook and SLA customer comms drafted before GA. I can coordinate comms with Support.

Ava (CEO): Thank you. Quick priorities: 1) stabilize P99 -> target <300ms; 2) GA checklist locked; 3) cost -10% by EOY (quarter cadence roadmap). I’ll run a 15m check-in Monday 09:00 PT with Rohan + Maya + Sam to validate progress.

Rohan (VP Eng): Will be there.

Sam (Head of Finance): Adding calendar invite.

Jen (People Ops): Noted. Will compile hiring exception list.

Ava (CEO): Closing loop: please post short updates to this thread as items progress. Thanks everyone — :raised_hands:
